action: Rakuten Securities advises customers to be careful with suspicious emails, SMS messages, phone calls and mail, and to set up passkey authentication.
date_note: Date the company says it learned a third party may have accessed its systems; Security NEXT published on 2026-11-18.
exec: Rakuten Securities says its second report found names, birth dates, addresses and phone numbers among the leaked customer data.
plain: Rakuten Securities' second report says about 4.41 million records include names, birth dates, addresses and phone numbers. The company says it has not confirmed a leak of passwords or PINs.
summary: Rakuten Securities said on 17 November that a third party may have accessed its systems. In its second report of 24 November, relayed by Impress Watch and INTERNET Watch, it said about 4.41 million accounts' data includes names, birth dates, addresses and phone numbers, and about 11.98 million hold only branch and customer codes, a total of about 16.39 million accounts. The company said no password or PIN leak was confirmed.
title: Rakuten Securities second report: leaked customer data includes names, addresses and phone numbers

validation.note: Security NEXT and ITmedia NEWS (read in full) independently report the company disclosure; ITmedia adds the company explanation that live data was copied to the test server. Rakuten Securities' own 19 Nov press release read: it states receipt of a report-collection order from the FSA that day; the earlier 17 Nov notice was not retrieved.

review.note: Compared 17 Nov announcement, 11.98M accounts, 4.41M records, data types, no password or PIN leak, no unauthorised trades against Impress Watch; two non-error warnings remain
